_meta.label: Feature Focus
_meta.instruction: One product capability should dominate. Translate it into user relevance. Other features stay in the background.

day_wise_pouches.label: Day-Wise Pouches
day_wise_pouches.definition: Dominate with the pre-portioned daily structure if that fact is supplied.

food_guidance.label: Food Guidance
food_guidance.definition: Dominate with what to eat or how homemade food fits, using only supplied guidance.

hunger_support.label: Hunger Support
hunger_support.definition: Dominate with the hunger or craving-support component.

coach_support.label: Coach Support
coach_support.definition: Dominate with coach chat, calls, or check-ins if supplied.

time_fit.label: Time Fit
time_fit.definition: Dominate with the short daily time claim if supplied.

kit_completeness.label: Kit Completeness
kit_completeness.definition: Dominate with the kit as a complete guided course rather than a single item.
